items.summary: AMD clang 24.0.0git (ROCm 10.2.0a20261022) aborts in the gfx942 device LTO link with 'LLVM ERROR: Cannot select: v4bf16 = scalar_to_vector' in ColossalAI's flash_decoding_attention_kernel_v1<__hip_bfloat16, uint8_t, 128, 32, 128> when fp8 bytes become bf16 through __float2bfloat16(__half2float(x)) stored as bf16x2 pairs. Worked around in the port (exact bit construction). Reproduces with the real TU and hipcc command; not yet reduced (no llc/llvm-reduce in the SDK).

Upstream bug, every platform: colossalai/nn/layer/scaled_softmax.py ScaledUpperTriangMaskedSoftmax.forward loads its kernel under 'if scaled_upper_triang_masked_softmax:' (should be 'is None'), so the fused causal softmax path raises AttributeError on first use. Not a port defect; reporting upstream is a person's call.

Upstream bug, every platform: FusedScaleMaskSoftmax.is_kernel_available dropped Megatron's 'sk % 4 == 0' condition; above 64 keys the scaled softmax kernels load 4 elements at a time, so ragged key lengths (127, 129, 511, 2047) give wrong probabilities (measured on gfx942, up to 0.36 absolute) or a misaligned load on NVIDIA. Not a port defect.

Upstream test fragility, every platform: tests/test_optimizer/test_adam_kernel.py::test_cpu_adam_kernel (fp16 params and grads) draws unseeded data and misses rtol=atol=1e-3 on 27 of 400 seeds; a plain-torch emulation of the same fp16 update misses on exactly the same seeds. Fails depending on test order.

Upstream test fragility, pre-existing: tests/test_model_zoo/test_gemma4.py::test_gemma4_cpu_ddp_equivalence[1-e2b] (CPU only) fails deterministically on a Zen 3 (AVX2, no AVX-512) host: model.layers.1.mlp.up_proj.weight error 6.11e-07 vs baseline 3.75e-08 (16.3x, limit 2x). Identical failure and numbers at upstream da3df39e; passed on the gfx942 host. Not a port defect; host-CPU dependence is a hypothesis. Reporting upstream is a person's call.

flash-attn 2.8.3.post2 Triton AMD backend (RDNA fa2 path): _bwd_preprocess reads dout with out's strides, so a non-contiguous dout gives wrong dq/dk (1.63 abs error; dv correct), and fwd returns rng_state=None without dropout, breaking torch.compile against the fake op. Both fixed on flash-attn main via ROCm/aiter f0966b0a; no release has them. Blocks ColossalAI's fa2 on gfx11/gfx12 with the released flash-attn; proposed port change in notes.md (gate the Triton backend on a newer flash-attn).
